title: MVD academy entrance hall guard room key

infobox.usage: Unlocks the guard room in the ministry of the interior academy building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: MVD academy entrance hall guard room key (MVD) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the guard room at the entrance hall inside the city MVD (Ministry of the Interior) academy.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the reception in the ministry of the interior academy building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Valuables, )
- Dead Scav
- Sports bag
- ORSIS T-5000M spawn
- PB pistol spawn
